title: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm
summary: Raft is a consensus algorithm for managing a replicated log. Raft produces a result equivalent to multi-Paxos and is as efficient as Paxos.

key_points.claim: Raft is a consensus algorithm for managing a replicated log
key_points.quote: Raft is a consensus algorithm for managing a replicated log.

key_points.claim: Raft produces a result equivalent to multi-Paxos and is as efficient as Paxos
key_points.quote: Raft produces a result equivalent to multi-Paxos and is as efficient as Paxos.

key_points.claim: A user study showed that Raft is easier for students to learn than Paxos
